scenario.goal_zh: 明确待清洁区域和离开房间前的操作

context_zh: 室友准备清理公共客厅，避免把高处的灰尘落到刚擦好的地板上。
author: author-phase05-b

sentences.speaker: Zara
sentences.text: There is a lot of dust on the windowsill. Shall I wipe it while you do the floor?

sentences.speaker: Finn
sentences.text: Do the high surfaces first, or the dust will fall on the clean floor.

sentences.speaker: Zara
sentences.text: Good point. There is also dirt around the door from our walking boots.

sentences.speaker: Finn
sentences.text: I will clean that after you finish. Please wipe along the edge of the shelf as well.

sentences.speaker: Zara
sentences.text: All right. I will do the shelf and windowsill, and you take the floor and doorway.

sentences.speaker: Finn
sentences.text: Agreed. When we leave, let us close the window and turn off the lamp.
